prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

(none yet)

(not available)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 78.0%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 77.4%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 71.1%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 93.5%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 70.9%, median 395s / mean 5815s

Return JSON {"scores": [{"index": i, "impact": n, "evidence": n, "confidence": n, "cost": n,
"predicted_lift": x, "note": short}]}

Changes:
0: [home, wait_info] Desktop Pet Habitat Builder Activity Module: Adds an interactive habitat builder minigame component to the waiting screen while background downloads finalize. (why: The waiting step (home) has a mean duration of 2336s, creating idle fatigue while waiting for rendering to complete.)
1: [adoption, hint] Custom Pet Face Centering Visual Guide Target: Displays an automated framing hint overlay on photo upload screens specifying face centering and lighting standards. (why: 3 support tickets highlighted custom pet rendering errors or poor visual output due to uncentered photo uploads.)
2: [sign_in, layout] Split-Screen Account Sign-In Layout: Reconfigures the sign-in screen into a split layout clearly contrasting guest progress protection against cloud backup benefits. (why: Users worry about losing adoption progress or having their pets reset during the sign-in step.)
3: [home, notification] Desktop Screen Overlay Access Permission Alert: Enables an active OS permission notification prompt on the waiting screen to verify overlay access before rendering. (why: 3 support complaints noted pets failing to appear on the desktop or the desktop application failing to spawn after waiting.)
4: [finish, copy] Desktop Tray Pinning Instructions Banner: Updates home intro headline and body text to explain how to dock and unhide the pet from the system taskbar. (why: Users frequently contact support post-onboarding asking how to bring back or manage hidden pets.)

scores.note: Home step dropoff is low (6.5%), and developing a habitat minigame requires significant effort.
Adoption step drops 28.9% of users; 3 support tickets explicitly cite photo upload rendering errors.
Addresses sign_in dropoff (22.6%) by clarifying progress retention, though lacks support ticket evidence.
Supported by 3 complaints regarding pet spawning, but home step conversion is already 93.5%.
Text/copy change directly targets high dropoff at finish step (29.1%) and frequent support complaints.
